items.reason: app/services/user_updater.rb:31 normalizes website values before saving, and format_url at lines 105–106 prepends http:// to example.com/user. The claimed input therefore reaches the serializer with a host; moreover, the base controller’s website.split("/")[2] already hid the unnormalized example, so that disappearance is not introduced here.

app/serializers/user_serializer.rb:143 deliberately builds a display label from host and path, consistent with this PR’s path-display scope; query and fragment are separate URL components. app/assets/javascripts/discourse/templates/user/user.hbs:69 retains the complete website as href, so the shortened label does not alter navigation or establish a broken contract.
